record.question: That is the girl whom I love.
record.explanation: Answer C: adjective clause. The relative clause “whom I love” modifies girl, hence adjective clause (C). Independent check: “Whom I love” is a relative clause modifying “girl,” so it is adjectival. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/relative-clauses.
